description: This is a shell script that automates building, testing, and coverage analysis for a complex software project involving multiple repositories and components, primarily focused on building the AppGateway L1 tests and generating coverage reports.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Outputs informational messages with a prefix.

methods.name: warn
methods.description: Outputs warning messages to standard error.

methods.name: err
methods.description: Outputs error messages to standard error.

methods.name: have_cmd
methods.description: Checks if a command is available in PATH.

methods.name: is_root
methods.description: Checks if the script is running with root privileges.

methods.name: apt_can_run
methods.description: Determines if apt-get can be executed (usually requires root or sudo).

methods.name: apt_get
methods.description: Runs apt-get with specific options, handling privileges.

methods.name: run_best_effort
methods.description: Runs a command and logs a warning if it fails, without stopping the script.

methods.name: git_noninteractive_env
methods.description: Sets environment variables to make git commands non-interactive.

methods.name: ensure_git_checkout_ref
methods.description: Checks out a specific git reference (tag, branch, remote) in a directory.

methods.name: ensure_repo_clone_and_checkout
methods.description: Clones a repository if not present, or fetches and checks out a specific reference.

methods.name: apply_patch_dir
methods.description: Applies a patch to a repository directory, handling already applied patches gracefully.

methods.name: build_dir_configured
methods.description: Checks whether a build directory has been configured with CMake.

methods.name: is_component_installed
methods.description: Heuristic to determine if a component (e.g., Thunder, gtest) is already installed based on presence of files/directories.

methods.name: cmake_configure_build_install
methods.description: Configures, builds, and installs a CMake project with verbose logging.

methods.name: cmake_configure_build_noinstall
methods.description: Configures and builds a CMake project without running install, to avoid copying files (useful in CI to prevent writing to /etc).
